Name: Terraprisma
Description:
Bring Terraria’s Terraprisma to Stardew Valley! Summon a formation of floating rainbow swords that follow you and automatically attack nearby monsters. The mod uses Terraria’s original sword sprites, with thrusting and slashing attacks adapted from its Terraprisma movement.
When idle, your blades gather in a fan formation behind your character. During combat, they rush toward enemies and sweep through them, leaving glowing afterimages and colored trails. A continuous rainbow gradient flows across the entire formation.
[list]
[*]Start with [b]1 summon slot[/b] and upgrade to [b]6 blades[/b].[/*]
[*]Each blade deals [b]30–40 base damage[/b], before applicable bonuses.[/*]
[*]Blades register hits independently, allowing several swords to damage the same enemy together.[/*]
[*]Supports vanilla gem forging and applicable combat enchantments.[/*]
[*]The weapon tooltip displays its current summon capacity.[/*]
[*]Blades continue fighting when you switch tools, provided their Terraprisma remains in your inventory.[/*]
[/list]Purchase the [b]Terraprisma crafting recipe for 50,000g[/b] from the Adventurer’s Guild. Once learned, craft the weapon using:
[list]
[*]5 Iridium Bars[/*]
[*]1 Prismatic Shard[/*]
[*]1 each of Amethyst, Topaz, Aquamarine, Jade, Ruby, Emerald, and Diamond[/*]
[/list]Equip Terraprisma and swing it to summon one blade per swing, up to that weapon’s current capacity. [b]Right-click[/b] uses the normal sword block; [b]Shift + right-click[/b] dismisses your blades. They follow you between locations. Summon them again after sleeping or reloading your save.
To increase capacity, place Terraprisma in the Volcano Forge’s left slot and a Prismatic Shard in the right slot:
[list]
[*][b]Shift + click the forge button:[/b] consume 1 Prismatic Shard to add one summon slot. No Cinder Shards are required.[/*]
[*][b]Click normally:[/b] apply a vanilla random enchantment, consuming 1 Prismatic Shard and 20 Cinder Shards.[/*]
[/list]Capacity upgrades belong to each individual weapon. They do not use gem-forging slots or replace existing enchantments. At [b]6 blades[/b], further capacity upgrades are blocked without consuming materials. Normal forging and enchanting remain available.
Installation requires Stardew Valley 1.6.9 or later and these dependencies:
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] — 4.1.10 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] — 2.9.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url] — 5.1.0[/*]
[/list]Extract the download and place all three folders—
[code]Terraprisma[/code],
[code][CP] Terraprisma[/code], and
[code][CC] Terraprisma[/code]—inside your game’s
[code]Mods[/code]folder. Launch through SMAPI. When updating, close the game and replace those three folders.
Tested in single-player on Windows with Stardew Valley 1.6.15. Multiplayer and split-screen have not been verified. Item names and base descriptions support English and Chinese; the additional capacity and forge hints currently appear in Chinese.
Terraprisma’s original artwork and design belong to [b]Re-Logic / Terraria[/b]. This mod uses [b]Custom Companions by PeacefulEnd[/b] for its companion entities and flight behavior.
